newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Tower Group says well ahead of targets in '96.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Tower Group says well ahead of targets in '96.

text.p: Tower Financial Services Group, releasing its annual report on Tuesday, said it had substantially exceeded all of its targets in 1996.

Tower said revenue was 53 percent above target for the year at $2.11 billion, assets were more than $1 billion ahead of target at $8 billion, and the group's solvency had increased to 23 percent despite bonuses rising 20 percent.
During the year, the company had also successfully completed the acquisition of Austrust.
While Austrust contributed significantly to the group's overall asset growth and revenue, Tower emphasised that the group was well ahead of its targets regardless of the Austrust impact.
Tower said the group had reached the position whereby approximately half its business was in Australia.
With regard to the prospect of demutualisation, Tower said management was assessing all options carefully.
"Our strong financial performance gives us some interesting options, which should be appealing to everyone who is investing with Tower," group chairman Colin Beyer said.
